Garchomp could also sweep later, but Gholdengo seems like the stronger immediate switch-in since Rotom's attacks are neutral or resisted against it.

Crunching the numbers against Scizor's likely defense range, the STAB and type advantage push Earthquake's damage well above Scizor's HP, so it should score the KO. Stone Edge would only be neutral against Scizor, making Earthquake clearly the better choice, and priority Bullet Punch is a risk I can't avoid anyway so I'll commit to Earthquake.
